additional_pdf_checks.scope: Final explicit 72-DPI page geometry and CSS-image scaling, worker-created PDF, embedded timeline image, atomic output, notes, row references and hash preservation

visual_preview.correlation: exact IP query with zoomed period

portable_case_checks: all ZIP CRCs and SHA-256 hashes read back before publication
every imported member hash verified before creating a case
source hashes compared with import metadata when transported
annotations, views and header states retained
new destination case and source-path rebinding
raw event values and path filter literals preserved
retained EVTX context source links rebound without changing row values
new EVTX context built after original workspaces removed
unsafe Windows paths, traversal and tampered packages rejected
recovery_checks: old filters restored without overwriting current database annotations
missing database prevents replacing current case
automatic save can be disabled and preference is persisted
report_checks: optional timeline figure with applied filter provenance
independent PDF text extraction preserves complete import SHA-256 values and row references
limitations: Native Windows frozen executable must pass its own CI qualification.
Synthetic performance results do not predict arbitrary forensic workloads.
Automatic history contains session metadata and references, not historical copies of annotations or databases.
Portable archive transports current case and collection outputs; keep raw collection artifacts and approved plugins for reruns.
Dates without timezone are flagged UTC assumptions; normalize source times explicitly when known.
Entity families are recognized from column names; exact matching does not canonicalize identities, IP addresses or paths.
Timeline is a refreshable snapshot. Display summaries are bounded; complete values remain in the source analysis.

final_failure_guards.scope: Recovery symlinks, cleanup errors after commit, incomplete PDF and renderer failure, worker PDF, portability and timeline UI
